k:孤.mnemonic: A child (子) sits by himself at the edge of the field with only a melon (瓜) for company. Nobody is coming to call him in. Orphan (alone).
k:孤.hint: A boy with only a melon.

k:笛.mnemonic: Wherefore (由) does this bamboo (竹) sing? Because someone has cut holes along it and is blowing across the top. Flute (clarinet, pipe, whistle).
k:笛.hint: A cane with holes that sings.

k:巧.mnemonic: On the construction (工) site there is one carpenter who can carve a baby's cradle (勹) from offcuts during his lunch break. Adroit (skilled, ingenuity).

k:賊.mnemonic: He comes in the night with a halberd (戈) and leaves with ten (十) bags of shellfish (貝) money over his shoulder. Burglar (rebel, traitor, robber).

k:尉.mnemonic: He stands under the flag (尸), checks every measurement (寸) of the ranks, and then gives the order to show (示) arms. Military officer (jailer, old man, rank).
k:尉.hint: Inspecting the ranks under the banner.

k:履.mnemonic: Whether you stroll (彳) under the flag (尸) on parade day (日) or trudge (夂) home through the mud, you need something on your feet. Footgear (perform, complete, shoes).
k:履.hint: Something for parade and mud alike.

k:疾.mnemonic: The fever reaches the sickbed (疒) like an arrow (矢): well at breakfast, flat on your back by lunch. Rapidly.

k:淡.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of water is poured over a double fire (火). The blaze shrinks to a pale flicker that you can barely see. Thin (faint, pale, fleeting).

k:蒸.mnemonic: A genius (才) of a cook lays flowers (艹) and greens on a rack over water and flames (灬), and they cook in the white cloud that rises. Steam (heat, sultry, foment).
k:蒸.hint: Greens cooking in a white cloud.

k:掃.mnemonic: A towel (巾) tied around the forehead (冖), fingers (扌) tight on the broom (ヨ), and the dust goes flying out of the door. Sweep (brush).
k:掃.hint: Headband on, dust out the door.

k:勲.mnemonic: In one day (日), by his own power (力), he carried ten thousand (万) buckets to the flames (灬) and saved the town. They pinned a medal on him. Meritorious deed (merit).

k:廊.mnemonic: Under the long canopy (广) the son (郎) runs up and down between the rooms, because it is the only place indoors with space to run. Corridor (hall, tower).

k:憎.mnemonic: His heartbeat (忄) pounds every day (日) that he looks across at the neighbour's rice field (田), the one taken from his family. Hate (detest).

k:殖.mnemonic: The dog keeps an eye (目) on his pile of bones (歹): one yesterday, ten (十) today, and the heap keeps on growing. Augment (increase, multiply, raise).

k:畳.mnemonic: A rectangle like a rice field (田), woven from straw. You kneel and bow until your forehead (冖) touches it. Tatami mat (fold, shut up, do away with).

k:薦.mnemonic: Under the canopy (广) of the tea stall, with flowers (艹) on the table and flames (灬) under the kettle, the owner tells you which blend you really ought to try. Recommend (mat, advise, encourage).

k:隻.mnemonic: One turkey (隹) held in the hand, and also (又) a tally mark for it. Birds are counted one by one like this, and so are ships in the harbour. Vessels (fish, birds, arrows).

k:霧.mnemonic: Rain (雨) too fine to fall just hangs in the air, and the watchman still on duty (務) cannot see his own lantern. Fog (mist).

k:猿.mnemonic: It is no hound (犭): it steals a garment (衣) from your washing line, climbs a tree with it, and will spit (吐) fruit stones down at you. Monkey.
k:猿.hint: The washing-line thief in the tree.

k:遭.mnemonic: At the bend (曲) in the path (辶) you come face to face with the very person you needed to speak to, and the questions begin. Interview (encounter, meet, party).
k:遭.hint: Face to face round the turn.

k:慰.mnemonic: A folded flag (尸) is handed to the family to show (示) respect: a small measurement (寸) of comfort for a heavy heart (心). Consolation (amusement, seduce, cheer).
k:慰.hint: A folded banner for the grieving.

k:粒.mnemonic: A piece of rice (米) so firm that it can stand (立) on end by itself. You could count them one at a time. Granule (grain, drop, grains).

k:膝.mnemonic: After a month (月) of climbing every tree (木) in sight, the joint in his leg swells with water (水). He rests his hat (𠆢) on it when he sits. Knee (lap).

k:嬢.mnemonic: A young woman (女) with six (六) dresses laid out on the bed, trying on one garment (衣) after another before the dance. Lass (girl, Miss, daughter).
k:嬢.hint: Choosing a dress for the dance.

k:粛.mnemonic: The servant (隶) carries the offering of rice (米) up the hall in complete silence, eyes lowered, every step slow. Solemn (quietly, softly).

k:曹.mnemonic: One (一) long counter, and behind it two rows of clerks who bend (曲) over their papers from morning until evening. Office (official, comrade, fellow).

k:慈.mnemonic: A heart (心) with room for even the most tiny (幺) creature: she carries the spider outside in a cup instead of squashing it. Mercy.
k:慈.hint: Spider carried out in a cup.

k:軸.mnemonic: Wherefore (由) does the car (車) wheel turn? Because of the rod through its middle, the one thing that everything else spins around. Axis (pivot, stem, stalk).

k:顕.mnemonic: Take the risk (冒) of turning the page (頁), and the picture that was hidden on the other side comes into view. Appear (existing).
k:顕.hint: Turn over and there it is.
